blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.
blocks.zh: 在人类皮层发育期间,功能系统变得日益不同. 我们询问,改进语文模式的推理是否涉及类似的区域重组。 应用扩散图嵌入,用来描述皮层组织特征,以匹配来自三个家族的基础和推理训练模型,我们发现,在毗连层间距内,具有局部变化的梯度分布图被广泛保存。 从这些跨度移到指令调试主机的权重平均改进了数学推理,随着区域重叠而增加收益,同时保留以前解决的问题比其他地方的权重多。 在整个培训中,这一阶段在业绩的早期提高期间逐渐形成,中间阶段的移植有所帮助。 大多数东道主部分转向捐助者的行为,有时在捐助者失败的问题上有所改进;同样的分析在医疗模式中找到一个可转移的时间段。 这些结论共同确定了一个推理相关区域,其权重在低干扰主机现有数学能力的情况下改善了推理.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Transferring an analysis of cortical organization to language models. The top row converts fMRI/BOLD signals into functional connectivity and applies diffusion-map embedding to obtain its principal gradient. The middle row applies the same sequence to language models: CKA converts sampled activations into a representational-similarity matrix, the model-side analogue of cortical functional connectivity, and diffusion-map embedding yields a principal gradient of representational similarity. The bottom row shows activation sampling: each representation node pairs one transformer layer with one of 11 retained sites in its attention and feed-forward computations. At each node, activation vectors from all valid tokens across the input texts are stacked into a matrix; the shared row order aligns observations across nodes for pairwise CKA.

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: Localized changes in model organization
blocks.zh: 示范组织的地方化变化

blocks.en: Gradient profiles were broadly preserved after reasoning training
blocks.zh: 经过推理培训后,大致保留了渐进图谱

blocks.en:
We first examined how the internal organization of language models differed before and after training to improve reasoning.
We compared six matched model pairs spanning the Ministral, Qwen and Llama families (M3B, M8B, M14B, Q7B, Q14B and L8B; the letter denotes the family and the number the parameter count in billions), using the same mathematical inputs within each pair.
The principal gradient assigned each sampled representation a coordinate according to its similarity relationships with the rest of the model (Fig. 1 ; Methods).
To compare these coordinates between models, we aligned the reasoning-trained model’s gradient coordinates to those of its base counterpart before averaging within layers (Methods).
Across all six pairs, the aligned gradient profiles retained similar overall shapes (Fig. 2 , upper plots).

blocks.en: Displacement formed localized peaks that defined a span in each model
blocks.zh: 流离失所形成局部高峰,确定每个模型的跨度

blocks.en:

Comparing coordinates at corresponding layers revealed differences that were less apparent from the overall profile shapes.
The displacement profiles showed localized peaks whose positions varied between model pairs and with the input dataset (Fig. 2 , lower plots).
We used the MATH-87 profiles to select one contiguous span of elevated displacement for each pair (Methods).
These spans occupied 15–35% of the layers, with mean displacement inside each span ranging from 1.29 to 2.69 times that outside it (Fig. 2 g).
The MATH-87 spans provided fixed layer intervals for the subsequent graft experiments.

blocks.en: Displacement did not track the magnitude of parameter change
blocks.zh: 移位没有跟踪参数变化的程度

blocks.en:
We then examined whether the gradient analysis identified the layers whose weights had changed most.
We measured parameter change using relative Frobenius distance 10 ; 22 , which summarizes how much a layer’s weights differ between models relative to their magnitude in the base model (Methods).
We compared this measure with gradient displacement across layers for both base–instruction and base–reasoning transitions (Extended Data Fig. 1 ).
Parameter change was spread across layers with no counterpart to the displacement peaks, and across the twelve comparisons the median Spearman correlation was ρ = − 0.014 \rho=-0.014 .
Gradient displacement therefore did not track the magnitude of weight change.
We next asked whether the weights within the identified spans could improve reasoning when inserted into another model.
blocks.zh:
然后,我们审查了梯度分析是否确定了加权变化最大的各层。
我们用相对的 Frobenius 距离 10; 22 来测量参数的变化,它总结了一个层的权重在基模型(Methods)中相对于其体积的不同程度.
我们比较了这一衡量标准与跨层梯度迁移,用于基础-教学和基础-合理过渡(扩展数据图1)。
参数变化分布在各层,与迁移高峰没有对应关系,在12个比较中,Spearman的中位关系为 ^ − 0.014\rho=- 0.014。
因此,逐渐迁移没有跟踪体重变化的程度。
我们接着问,如果插入另一个模型,所确定跨度内的权重能否改进推理。

blocks.en: Reasoning gains from regional grafting
blocks.zh: 区域移植的合理收益

blocks.en:
We tested this possibility by copying all parameters of the identified span from each reasoning-trained model into the matched instruction-tuned model, without further training (Methods).
The span identified using MATH-87 was held fixed for evaluation on MATH-87, AIME 2024 and AIME 2025.
We asked whether these grafts improved mathematical accuracy, whether the gain depended on where the weights came from, and whether the inputs used to identify the span mattered.
blocks.zh:
我们测试了这种可能性,将所确定的跨度的所有参数从每个经过推理训练的模型复制到匹配的指令调整模型中,而不进行进一步的培训(方法)。
使用MATH-87确定的时间段固定在MATH-87、AIME 2024和AIME 2025上进行评价。
我们问,这些移植是否提高了数学的准确性,收益是否取决于权重的来源,以及用于确定跨度的投入是否重要。

blocks.en: Grafts from the identified spans improved mathematical accuracy on average
blocks.zh: 平均数字精确度提高

blocks.en:
Averaged across the six instruction-tuned models, accuracy increased relative to the ungrafted models by 3.2 percentage points on MATH-87 (95% confidence interval, 0.8 0.8 to 5.6 5.6 ), 4.2 points on AIME 2024 ( 1.8 1.8 to 6.6 6.6 ) and 5.1 points on AIME 2025 ( 1.2 1.2 to 9.1 9.1 ; Fig. 3 a).
The larger mean gains on AIME extended beyond the selection problems, but were not universal: on AIME 2024, accuracy fell by 1.9 points in L8B and 0.6 points in M14B (Extended Data Table 1 c).
blocks.zh:
平均而言,在六个经指导调整的模型中,与未移植的模型相比,准确度在MATH-87上提高了3.2个百分点(95%的置信间隔,0.8至5.6 5.6),在AIME 2024上提高了4.2个百分点(1.8至6.6 6.6),在AIME 2025上提高了5.1个百分点(1.2至9.1 9.1;图3 a)。
AIME上较大的平均收益超出了选择问题,但并不普遍:在AIME 2024上,准确度在L8B上下降了1.9分,在M14B上下降了0.6分. (扩展数据表1c).

blocks.en: Gains rose with the graft’s overlap with the identified span
blocks.zh: 增益随着收入与确定范围重叠而增加

blocks.en:
We compared the identified span with grafts containing the same number of layers at other positions (Methods and Extended Data Fig. 2 ).
On all three benchmarks, accuracy averaged across models increased from no overlap through low and high overlap with the identified span and was greatest at full overlap, and grafts with no overlap reduced accuracy on average relative to the ungrafted models (Fig. 3 a).
The graft at the identified span also exceeded the mean accuracy of the other evaluated positions in the point estimates of all 18 model–benchmark comparisons (Fig. 3 b).
On the basis of these results, we refer to the identified span in each reasoning-trained model as its reasoning-related region.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了所查明的跨度和其他位置上包含同样数量层的地层(方法及扩展数据图2)。
在所有三项基准中,各模型的平均准确度从与所确定的跨度的低和高重叠程度从无重叠程度上升,完全重叠程度最高,与无重叠模型相比,平均准确度没有重叠(图3a)。
所确定期间的运费也超过了所有18个模型-基准比较(图3b)的点估计中其他评价职位的平均准确度。
基于这些结果,我们把每个经过推理训练的模型中所确定的跨度称为与推理有关的区域。

blocks.en:
We also compared the region graft with equally wide grafts positioned using peaks in relative Frobenius distance or CKA similarity-profile change.
Region grafts had higher mean accuracy than both alternatives in all 18 host–benchmark comparisons (Extended Data Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们还利用相对Frobenius距离的峰值或CKA的相似性变化,将区域移植与同样宽的移植进行对比。
在所有18个主机-基准比较中,区域移植的平均精确度都高于这两个替代品(扩展数据图2)。

blocks.en: Gains extended to MATH-500 problems not used to identify the span
blocks.zh: 未用于确定跨度的MATH-500问题的收益

blocks.en:
Because each span was identified from 87 MATH-500 problems, we evaluated the region grafts on the remaining 413 problems in a single generation run.
Accuracy rose in five of six hosts, by 0.7 to 3.6 percentage points, matching the direction of change on the 87 selection problems; in M14B, where the graft left selection accuracy unchanged, held-out accuracy fell by 1.0 points (Extended Data Table 2 ).
The reasoning-trained models themselves exceeded their hosts on these problems in four sets and fell below them in M8B and M14B.
blocks.zh:
由于每个跨度是从87个MATH-500问题中确定出来的,我们评价了在一代人运行中剩下的413个问题的区域移植.
在六个主机中,有五个主机的准确度上升了0.7至3.6个百分点,与87个选择问题的变化方向相匹配;在M14B中,重力使选择精度保持不变,所保持的精度下降了1.0个百分点(扩展数据表2 ).
在这些问题上,经过推理训练的模型本身在四组中都超过了他们的主机,在M8B和M14B中都降到了下方.

blocks.en: Spans selected from AIME problems were less effective, even on AIME
blocks.zh: 从 AIME 问题中挑选的 Spans 效果较差, 甚至在 AIME 上也是如此

blocks.en:
To examine what made an input dataset useful for identifying a span, we repeated the gradient analysis on AIME problems, on which the reasoning-trained models were less accurate than on MATH-87, keeping the model pairs unchanged.
The resulting spans overlapped the MATH-87 region in two of six model pairs for AIME 2024 and in none for AIME 2025.
When each span was evaluated on the benchmark used to identify it, against three randomly drawn grafts of the same width outside the span, the selected graft exceeded their mean in five of six models for MATH-87, three for AIME 2024 and one for AIME 2025 (Extended Data Table 1 a).
blocks.zh:
为了研究一个输入数据集对识别一个跨度有用的因素,我们重复了对AIME问题的梯度分析,在梯度分析上,推理训练模型比MATH-87上的更准确,使模型对数保持不变.
由此产生的跨度将MATH-87区域重叠为AIME 2024的六个型号对中的两个型号,而AIME 2025的型号对无型号.
每个跨度在用于识别的基准上被评价时,对照跨度外的3个随机抽取的相同宽度的切片,选取的切片在MATH-87的6种模型中,有5种超过了其平均值,3种为AIME 2024,1种为AIME 2025(扩展数据表1a).

blocks.en: Gains were less consistent for spans selected from non-mathematical text
blocks.zh: 从非数学文本中选择的跨度收益不太一致

blocks.en:
Using Wikipedia text and random word sequences as inputs, we repeated the gradient analysis and grafted weights from the resulting spans, keeping the model pairs and selection rule unchanged.
Alternative spans sometimes improved accuracy but generally yielded smaller gains than the MATH-87 region; the non-overlapping Wikipedia span nevertheless exceeded it for M14B on AIME 2024 (Extended Data Table 1 b,c).
blocks.zh:
使用维基百科文本和随机词序作为输入,我们重复了梯度分析以及从所产生的跨度中引出的加权,使模型对和选择规则保持不变.
替代品的精度有时会提高,但收益一般小于MATH-87区域;然而,在AIME 2024上,维基百科的精度超过M14B(扩展数据表1b,c)。

blocks.en: Solution length and effects on other abilities
blocks.zh: 解决方案长度和对其他能力的影响

blocks.en: Region grafts lengthened solutions on average
blocks.zh: 平均延长的解决方案

blocks.en:
Reasoning training lengthens solutions, which come to contain intermediate calculations, checks and alternative approaches 4 .
We therefore asked whether region grafts also transferred this tendency, comparing median response length across graft positions on the three mathematics benchmarks.
On all three benchmarks, responses were longer on average for region grafts than for non-overlapping grafts (Extended Data Fig. 3 a).
blocks.zh:
培训的合理延长办法,包括中间计算、核对和替代办法
因此,我们询问区域移植是否也转移了这一趋势,比较了三个数学基准的移植位置的中位响应长度。
在所有三项基准中,区域移植的答复平均比非重叠移植的答复要长(扩展数据图3a)。

blocks.en: Forced continuation did not consistently reproduce the graft gains
blocks.zh: 强迫延续没有一贯地复制收获

blocks.en:
To test whether longer solutions could reproduce the gains, we made five ungrafted hosts continue whenever they stopped before either of two set lengths (Methods).
On MATH-87, region grafts had higher mean accuracy than both forced conditions in L8B, Q14B and M3B, while the shorter forced condition exceeded the region graft in M8B and M14B.
On AIME 2024 and AIME 2025, region grafts had higher mean accuracy than both forced conditions in Q14B and all three Ministral hosts, including cases where forced solutions were longer; L8B accuracy remained near zero (Extended Data Table 3 ).
blocks.zh:
为了检验更长的解决方案是否能够复制这些成果,我们让5个未移植的主机在两个固定长度(方法)之前的任一时间停止时继续运行.
在MATH-87上,区域移植的平均精度高于L8B,Q14B和M3B的强制条件,而较短的强制条件超过了M8B和M14B的强制条件。
在AIME 2024和AIME 2025上,区域移植的平均精度高于Q14B和所有三个部委主机的强制条件,包括强制溶液时间更长的情况;L8B精度仍然接近于零(扩展数据表3 )。

blocks.en: Factual recall and language modelling changed in both directions
blocks.zh: 事实召回和语言建模双向变化

blocks.en:
We also examined whether the grafted models moved towards the reasoning-trained models in factual recall and language modelling, using TriviaQA and Wikipedia.
Grafting changed TriviaQA accuracy by − 5.0 -5.0 to + 2.8 +2.8 percentage points relative to the ungrafted models, and in the five sets where the reasoning-trained model held an advantage of 7.6 to 21.8 points the grafted model remained closer to the instruction-tuned model (Extended Data Fig. 3 b).
Wikipedia perplexity likewise changed in both directions, by − 3.1 -3.1 to + 1.3 +1.3 (Extended Data Fig. 3 c).
The mathematical gains thus occurred without a corresponding transfer of the donors’ factual-recall advantage.
blocks.zh:
我们还研究了被移植的模型是否在事实召回和语言建模中转向了推理训练的模型,使用TriviaQA和维基百科.
牵引将TriviaQA的精度与未牵引模型的精度比比为−5.0-5.0改为+2.8+2.8个百分点,在推理训练模型的优势为7.6至21.8分的五组中,牵引模型仍然更接近于指令调制模型(Extended Data Fig. 3b).
维基百科的迷惑性同样在两个方向上都发生了变化,由 − 3.1-3.1 改为 + 1.3 + 1.3(扩展数据图3 c).
因此,数学收益的产生没有相应转移捐助者的事实召回优势。

blocks.en: Reasoning gains with low interference
blocks.zh: 低干扰的理性收益

blocks.en:
We next asked whether the grafted models retained the problems they could already solve, since a gain in overall accuracy can conceal newly incorrect answers outnumbered by newly correct ones.
We therefore tracked individual problems before and after grafting, for the region and for equally wide grafts that did not overlap it.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来问道,被移植的模型是否保留了它们已经解决的问题,因为总体准确度的提高可以掩盖新错误的答案被新正确的答案所忽略。
因此,我们追踪了该地区和没有重叠的同样宽广的采摘前后的个别问题。

blocks.en: Region grafts retained more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere
blocks.zh: 与其他地方相比,以往解决的问题较多

blocks.en: Across the six models and three benchmarks, region grafts retained 91.9% of previously solved problems against 82.2% for non-overlapping grafts (difference 9.6 percentage points; 95% confidence interval, 7.2 to 12.1) and solved 18.1% of previously unsolved problems against 10.0%.
blocks.zh: 在6个模式和3个基准中,地区移植保留了91.9%的以前解决的问题,而非重叠移植保留了82.2%的问题(差异9.6个百分点;95%的置信间隔,7.2至12.1),解决了18.1%的以前未解决的问题,10.0%。

blocks.en: Newly solved problems outnumbered newly unsolved ones in every model
blocks.zh: 在所有模式中,新解决的问题都超过了新解决的问题

blocks.en:
Within individual models, after pooling the three benchmarks, newly solved problems outnumbered newly unsolved ones in all six models with region grafts, whereas the net change was negative in all six with non-overlapping grafts (Table 1 ; Extended Data Table 4 ).
The region thus supported mathematical improvement while preserving more of the instruction-tuned models’ existing correct answers than equally sized replacements elsewhere.
blocks.zh:
在单个模式中,在将三个基准合并之后,在所有六个模式中,新解决的问题都超过了新未解决的问题,而在所有六个模式中,净变化是负的,而不是重叠的(表1;扩展数据表4)。
因此,该区域支持改进数学,同时保留更多的经指导调整的模型的现有正确答案,而不是其他地方大小相同的替代。

blocks.en: How do reasoning-related regions develop during training?
blocks.zh: 与推理有关的区域在培训期间如何发展?

blocks.en:
In cortical development, the principal gradient shifts gradually over childhood and adolescence as reasoning abilities emerge 2 .
This prompted us to ask whether a reasoning-related region likewise takes shape gradually during training.
We examined OLMo 3 7B 18 , whose intermediate stages of reasoning training are publicly available, and followed layers 8–14 from the base model to the end of supervised fine-tuning (Methods).
A maturity index summarized how far the displacement pattern across these layers had progressed at each stage, from zero for the base model to one at the end of training (Methods).
We asked when the pattern formed, whether its formation accompanied gains in performance, and whether grafts from the region already helped while the pattern was still forming.
blocks.zh:
在皮层发育中,随着推理能力的出现,主要的梯度逐渐向童年和青春期转移。
这促使我们问一个与推理有关的区域在培训期间是否也逐渐形成。
我们检查了OLMo 3 7B 18, 其推理培训的中间阶段是公开的, 并遵循从基数模型到监督微调(方法)结束的8-14层。
成熟程度指数总结了这些层层的迁移模式在每个阶段的进展程度,从基本模型的零到培训结束时的一(方法)。
我们问,这种模式是何时形成的,其形成是否伴随着业绩的提高,以及从该区域得到的遗产在这种模式仍在形成期间是否已经有所帮助。

blocks.en: The regional pattern formed gradually and separated from the rest of the model
blocks.zh: 区域模式逐渐形成,并与其他模式分离

blocks.en:
Displacement appeared at layers 12–13 within the first 1,000 steps and at layer 14 by 2,000 steps, and only later at layers 8–11; the maturity index was 0.09 at 1,000 steps and 0.41 at 2,000, reached 0.97 by 12,000 steps and thereafter fluctuated around one (Fig. 4 a,c).
As training progressed, the region grew less similar to the rest of the model, the layers above it more alike and those below less so, and similarity within the region rose early and then fell below its base level (Fig. 4 b).
blocks.zh:
迁移出现在前1,000步的第12至13层和第14步第2000步的第8至11层;成熟指数在前1,000步第0.09级,在前2,000步第0.41级,达到0.97级,然后在后1级左右波动(图4 a,c)。
随着培训的进展,该区域与模型其他部分的相似程度降低,其上层与下层的相似程度提高,区域内的相似程度提前上升,然后下降到低于基准水平(图4b)。

blocks.en: Regional maturity tracked the early rise in performance
blocks.zh: 区域成熟程度跟踪业绩的早期上升

blocks.en:
Across the intermediate stages, the maturity index correlated with accuracy on MATH-87 ( r = 0.97 r=0.97 ), AIME 2024 ( r = 0.91 r=0.91 ) and AIME 2025 ( r = 0.96 r=0.96 ), more closely than the same index computed for any of the 13 equally wide spans that did not overlap the region, with the smallest margin on AIME 2025 (0.96 against 0.92; Extended Data Fig. 4 a,b).
After 12,000 steps, maturity stayed near one (Fig. 4 c), while AIME accuracy rose by another 13 to 18 percentage points by the endpoint (Supplementary Note “OLMo stage accuracy and graft positions across training”).
The region’s formation thus coincided with the early rise in performance, while later gains arose without a sustained increase in regional maturity.
blocks.zh:
在整个中间阶段,成熟指数与MATH-87(r = 0.97 r = 0.97)、AIME 2024(r = 0.91 r = 0.91)和 AIME 2025(r = 0.96 r = 0.96)的精确度相关,比13个同等宽度且不与该区域重叠的任意一个指数更接近,而AIME 2025的比值最小(0.96对0.92;扩展数据图4 a,b)。
经过12,000个步骤后,成熟度保持在1个步骤(图4c)附近,而到终点时,AIME的准确度又上升了13至18个百分点(补充说明“OLMo舞台准确度和整个培训的移植位置”)。
因此,本区域的形成与业绩的早期提高同时进行,而后来则在区域成熟程度没有持续提高的情况下产生收益。

blocks.en: Grafts from the region helped while the pattern was still forming
blocks.zh: 本区域的梯队帮助了这一模式仍在形成

blocks.en:
We grafted the region from each stage of training into the base model from which all stages descend (Fig. 4 d).
On MATH-87, the gain rose irregularly from 0.4 percentage points for the earliest donor to 11.5 at 12,000 steps and 14.6 at 20,000 steps, then fell back to 6.9 and 8.0 for the two latest donors in every generation run.
On AIME, where the base host answered only 9 and 6 of 120 responses correctly, grafts from every donor raised accuracy by about 2 to 8 percentage points with no consistent trend across stages (Methods).
The benefit on MATH-87 thus rose and fell with the donor’s training stage, whereas on AIME it was present from the earliest stage.
blocks.zh:
我们从每个培训阶段将该区域纳入所有阶段降级的基准模式(图4d)。
在MATH-87上,收益不规则地从最早的捐助者的0.4个百分点上升到11.5步,12,000步,14.6步,然后又下降到每代最新两个捐助者的6.9和8.0。
在AIME上,基础主机仅正确回答120个回复中的9个和6个,每个捐赠者的移植将准确度提高了约2至8个百分点,不同阶段之间没有一致的趋势(方法).
因此,MATH-87的好处随着捐助者的培训阶段而增加和减少,而AIME则从最初阶段就存在。

blocks.en: Do grafting gains track donor-like behaviour?
blocks.zh: 移植收益是否追踪捐助方行为?

blocks.en:
Returning to the six matched model sets, we asked whether hosts that received a graft had also come to behave like their donors, comparing equally wide grafts at different positions along the model.
The donor-trace score measures how far a graft’s word-by-word predictions on the donor’s solutions move from the host’s towards the donor’s.
The generated-solution score instead compares how probable the graft’s own solutions are under the donor and host.
Both scores are normalized to zero for the host and one for the donor (Methods).
As before, we grouped grafts by their overlap with the region (Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
回到六个匹配的模型组时,我们问,接受移植的东道主是否也象他们的捐赠者一样,在模型的不同位置上比较同样宽的移植。
捐赠者追踪的得分衡量着捐赠者对捐赠者解决办法的逐字预测从东道方走向捐赠者的程度。
而生成解决方案得分则比较了捐赠方和东道方自身解决方案的可能性。
东道主和捐赠者(方法)的分数都归为零。
与以往一样,我们按其与该区域的重叠(图3)分类。

blocks.en: Region grafts were more donor-like than non-overlapping grafts in five hosts
blocks.zh: 在5个东道主中,区域移植比非重叠移植更像捐赠者

blocks.en:
Both scores increased from grafts with no overlap to the region graft on all three benchmarks in five hosts; M8B moved the opposite way (Extended Data Fig. 5 a,b).
M14B nevertheless remained farther from its donor than the ungrafted host on donor traces.
Even region grafts stayed well short of the donor: generated-solution scores reached 0.3 to 0.7 in Q7B and M3B and stayed below 0.4 in the other hosts.
In M8B, the region graft raised AIME 2024 accuracy by 7.5 percentage points while being less donor-like than grafts with no overlap.
blocks.zh:
在五个主机的所有三个基准上,这两个分数都由没有重叠到区域分数的增加;M8B移动方式相反(Extend Data Fig. 5 a,b).
然而,M14B与其捐助者相比,仍然远于捐助者留下的未分配东道国。
甚至区域分流也远远低于捐助者:在Q7B和M3B中,生成的溶液分数达到0.3至0.7,在其他主机中则保持在0.4以下.
在M8B中,区域移植将AIME 2024的精度提高了7.5个百分点,同时与没有重叠的移植相比,捐赠者类型较少.

blocks.en: Grafts also improved on problems their donors did not solve
blocks.zh: 捐赠者没有解决的问题也有所改善

blocks.en:
On AIME, the Q7B, L8B and Q14B grafts, whose donors were distilled from the same teacher, gained almost exclusively on problems the donor solved but the host did not (Extended Data Table 5 ).
The M3B, M8B and M14B grafts also gained on problems that neither host nor donor solved.
Correlations between problem-level gains and donor accuracy showed no consistent advantage for the own donor over the mean for the other five ( Δ ​ ρ \Delta\rho from − 0.29 -0.29 to + 0.08 +0.08 ).
Grafts also rarely reproduced wrong answers that their donor gave but the host did not, with Q7B the only host where the rate rose by more than three points (Extended Data Table 5 ).
Taken together, grafting shifted most hosts partly towards their donors’ behaviour, with gains extending to problems their donors did not solve.
blocks.zh:
在AIME上,Q7B,L8B和Q14B移植器,其捐献者来自同一老师,几乎完全是在捐献者解决但东道主没有解决的问题上获得的(扩展数据表5).
M3B型,M8B型和M14B型牵引车也获得了无论是主机还是捐赠方都没有解决的问题.
问题层面收益与捐助方准确性之间的关联表明,相对于其他五个捐助方的平均值而言,本国捐助方没有一贯的优势( ^\\Delta\rho从−0.29-0.29到+0.08+0.08)。
Grafts也很少转载其捐赠者给出的但东道主没有的错误答案,Q7B是唯一一个率上升超过三分的东道主. (扩展数据表5).
归根结底,大部分东道国部分转向捐助者的行为,其收益延伸到捐助者未能解决的问题。

blocks.en: Does regional grafting extend to a medical model?
blocks.zh: 区域移植是否延伸到医疗模式?

blocks.en:
The preceding experiments concerned models trained to improve reasoning.
We extended the analysis to UltraMedical, a medical specialization of the 8B Llama instruction-tuned model 21 , comparing its representations with those of the corresponding base model on MedQA questions 7 and selecting layers 13–18 from the resulting displacement profile (Methods).
We first tested whether this span transferred medical competence to the instruction-tuned parent.
We then examined whether reasoning grafts improved mathematical performance while preserving medical accuracy and existing correct answers, and how these effects depended on graft position.
blocks.zh:
前面的实验涉及为改进推理而培训的模型。
我们把分析推广到超医学,这是8B Llama 指示调试型号21的医学专业,将其表述与MedQA问题7上的相应基模型的表述作比较,并从产生的迁移概况(方法)中选择第13至18层。
我们首先测试了这一阶段是否将医疗能力转移给指导性父母。
然后我们研究推理移植是否在保持医学准确性和现有正确答案的同时提高了数学性能,以及这些效果如何取决于移植位置.

blocks.en: The gradient analysis located a transferable span in the medical model
blocks.zh: 梯度分析确定医疗模型中可转移的跨度

blocks.en:
Grafting the medical model’s weights at layers 13–18 into its instruction-tuned parent raised MedQA accuracy by 6.4 percentage points (Fig. 5 a).
The reverse exchange, which replaced the same span in the medical model with its parent’s weights, changed medical accuracy by 0.9 points.
The span thus carried competence that transferred to the parent, while the medical model’s own competence did not rest on that span alone.
blocks.zh:
将医疗模型在13至18层的权重移入其经指导调整的母体,使医疗质量评估的精确度提高了6.4个百分点(图5a)。
反向交换用其母体重取代了医疗模型的相同间距,使医疗精度改变0.9分.
因此,这一期限将能力转移给父母,而医疗模式本身的能力则不只取决于这一期限。

blocks.en: Reasoning grafts changed medical accuracy little at intermediate positions
blocks.zh: 中间位置医疗准确性几乎没有改变

blocks.en:
We then grafted the reasoning-related region (layers 15–22) from the matched reasoning-trained model into the medical model, without further training, and evaluated MATH-87 and MedQA.
Medical accuracy stayed close to the ungrafted level, and mathematical accuracy rose by 3.4 points with an interval that included zero (Fig. 5 c).
Grafts of the same width at 13 other positions depended on location: early positions reduced accuracy on both benchmarks, intermediate positions overlapping the region gave higher mathematical point estimates with little change in medical accuracy, and the final eight layers sharply reduced medical accuracy and often produced repetitive generation (Fig. 5 c).
blocks.zh:
我们随后将推理相关区域(第15至22层)从经过相应推理训练的模型移植到医学模型中,没有经过进一步训练,并对MATH-87和MedQA进行了评价。
医学精度保持接近未分泌水平,数学精度上升3.4分,间隔包括0(图5 c).
13个其他位置的宽度相同的移位取决于位置:早期位置降低了两个基准的精确度,中间位置重叠的区域给出了较高的数学点估计,医学精确度几乎没有变化,最后的8层急剧降低医学精确度,并经常产生重复生成(图5c).

blocks.en: The region preserved more existing medical answers than the span with the largest mathematical gain
blocks.zh: 该区域保存了比整个期间更多的现有医疗答案,其数学收益最大

blocks.en:
At layers 10–17, the position with the largest mathematical gain, equal numbers of newly correct and newly incorrect answers left overall medical accuracy unchanged, and 86% of the previously correct medical answers remained correct, against 91% for the region (Fig. 5 b).
Within the medical model as well, the region thus traded a smaller mathematical gain for less loss of existing answers.
blocks.zh:
在10至17层,数学收益最大的位置,新正确和新错误答案的相同数字使总体医学准确性保持不变,86%以前正确的医学答案仍然正确,而该地区的数字为91%(图5b)。
在医疗模式中,该区域也因此以较少的数学收益换取了现有答案的损失。

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Cortical gradient analysis linked changes in language-model organization to locations where exchanging weights improved performance.
It described each representation through its relationships with other representations, yielding localized differences that did not track the magnitude of parameter change.
The graft experiments gave these differences functional relevance: weights from the identified spans improved mathematical reasoning on average, with outcomes depending on location, host and benchmark.
This connects a description of representational organization to an intervention on the model’s computation.
blocks.zh:
横向梯度分析将语言模式组织的变化与交换权重提高绩效的地点联系起来。
它通过与其他代表的关系来描述每一种代表,产生局部差异,无法跟踪参数变化的程度。
移植实验给出了这些不同的功能关联性:从所确定的跨度的权重平均来说改善了数学推理,结果取决于位置,宿主和基准.
这就把代表组织的说明与模型计算方面的干预联系起来。

blocks.en:
The choice of inputs shaped which differences the analysis revealed.
MATH-87 elicited more consistent graft gains than AIME or non-mathematical text, suggesting that inputs within a model’s capabilities may reveal functionally useful changes more clearly.
L8B’s MATH-87 graft improved MATH-87 accuracy but left AIME accuracy near zero (Extended Data Table 1 c), showing that identifying a span need not confer reliable performance on harder problems.
Gains on held-out MATH-500 problems in five of six hosts nevertheless extended beyond the inputs used for localization.
blocks.zh:
选择不同分析显示的投入。
MATH-87获得比AIME或非数学文本更一致的增益,表明模型能力内的投入可能更清楚地揭示功能上有用的变化。
L8B的MATH-87移植提高了MATH-87的精度,但使得AIME精度接近零(扩展数据表1c),表明识别一个跨度不需要给更难的问题带来可靠的性能.
然而,在六个主机的五个主机中,关于被搁置的MATH-500问题的收益超出了用于本地化的投入。

blocks.en:
The value of a regional graft depended on what the host retained as well as what it gained.
Higher retention alongside recovery suggests that the transferred weights could support new correct answers while working with the host’s remaining layers.
The partial shift towards donor behaviour, together with gains on problems the donor failed, likewise points to an effect shaped by the receiving model.
The asymmetric medical exchange further shows that a span can carry transferable competence even when replacing it in the donor has little effect.
Preservation also mattered when choosing between graft positions: in the medical host, the region preserved more existing correct answers than the position with the largest mathematical gain.
Selecting a graft by its gain on one benchmark alone can therefore overlook disruption to competence already present in the host.
blocks.zh:
区域移植的价值取决于东道方所保留的内容和所得。
在回收的同时,较高的留存率表明,转移的权重可以支持新的正确答案,同时与东道主的其余各层合作。
向捐助者行为的部分转变,加上捐助者未能解决问题,同样表明了接受模式形成的效果。
非对称性医疗交换进一步表明,即使捐助方更换,一个跨度也可能具有可转移的能力,但效果甚微。
在选择移植位置时,保存也很重要:在医学宿主中,该区域保存的正确答案比数学收益最大的位置要多。
因此,仅仅根据一个基准来选择一项成果,就可能忽略对东道国现有能力的干扰。

blocks.en:
The training trajectory separates the formation of the regional pattern from subsequent gains in performance.
Grafts were already useful while the regional pattern was forming, and performance continued to improve after maturity approached its endpoint level.
The final pattern thus marks a change in organization whose formation accompanies only part of the improvement during training.
How the region interacts with the rest of the model as training proceeds remains an open question, particularly because later donor stages did not consistently yield larger graft gains.
blocks.zh:
培训轨迹将区域模式的形成与随后的业绩收益区分开来。
在区域模式形成期间,抽水管已经有用,成熟程度接近终点后,业绩继续改善。
因此,最后的模式标志着组织的变化,其组成只是培训期间改进的一部分。
随着培训的进展,该区域如何与模式的其余部分互动仍然是一个未决问题,特别是因为后来的捐助者阶段未能持续产生更大的收益。

blocks.en:
Several limits qualify these conclusions.
Region localization depends on the reference model, inputs and selection threshold, and may be less informative when inputs exceed a model’s capabilities. The selected spans need not maximize graft accuracy.
The input sets differed in content, size and difficulty, leaving the role of model competence unresolved.
Forced continuation did not consistently reproduce graft gains, but its effects varied by host and benchmark and it did not match solution lengths in every comparison.
Isolating changes specific to reasoning would require matched comparisons with other forms of post-training.
The trajectory involved one model family and one graft host, and the behavioural comparisons were descriptive.
Functional validation centred on mathematics and architecturally matched models, with a limited medical extension.
blocks.zh:
这些结论有若干限制。
区域本地化取决于参考模型、投入和选择门槛,如果投入超过模型的能力,则信息可能较少。 选定的跨度不需要最大程度的精度。
投入集的内容、规模和难度各不相同,使示范权限的作用得不到解决。
强制延续并非一贯地复制移植收益,但其影响因主机和基准而异,在每次比较中并不匹配解决方案长度.
孤立特定推理的变化需要与其他形式培训后的比较。
轨迹涉及一个模式家庭和一个移植主机,行为比较是描述性的。
功能验证以数学和建筑匹配模型为中心,医学扩展有限.

blocks.en:
These findings motivate using representational organization to guide weight exchange while evaluating both improvement and preservation of existing answers.
Broader comparisons of selection rules across models and abilities would establish where this approach is most useful.
blocks.zh:
这些结论激励利用代表组织指导权重交换,同时评价现有答案的改进和保留。
对不同模式和能力的选择规则进行更广泛的比较,将确定这种办法最有用之处。

blocks.en: Methods
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: Models
blocks.zh: 模型

blocks.en:
The main reasoning analysis used six architecture- and scale-matched model triplets spanning 3B to 14B parameters: three Ministral sizes, two Qwen sizes and one Llama size 12 ; 20 ; 3 ; 4 .
Each triplet, referred to here as a matched model set, contained a base, an instruction-tuned and a reasoning-trained model.
The Qwen and Llama reasoning models were distilled from DeepSeek-R1, whereas the Ministral reasoning models underwent supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning and preference optimization 4 ; 12 .
The instruction-tuned model served as the host and no-graft reference because it reliably followed the evaluation prompts. Using this post-trained host was intended to reduce confounding from instruction following and response formatting relative to a base-model host.
The base–reasoning comparison defined the gradient-displacement profile and the reasoning-related region; we then assessed its functional relevance by replacing the corresponding layer weights in the instruction-tuned model with those of the reasoning-trained model. Matching within each model set ensured identical layer structure and parameter dimensions. Exact model identifiers, layer counts, representation-node counts, and architecture and projection dimensions are reported in Supplementary Table 1.
blocks.zh:
主要推理分析使用了6个架构和比例匹配的模型三进制,跨越3B到14B参数:3个政府大小,2个Quen大小和一个Llama大小12;20;3;4.
每个三胞胎,这里称为匹配的模型集, 包含一个基础,一个指令调整和一个推理训练的模型。
Quen和Llama推理模型是从DeepSeek-R1中提炼出来的,而Ministry推理模型则经过监督的微调,然后进行了强化学习和偏好优化4;12。
指示调制模式作为主机和无引力的参考,因为它可靠地遵循了评价提示. 使用这一经过培训后的主机是为了减少与基准模式主机相比,从指令和响应格式化中产生的混乱。
基础-理性比较定义了梯度-迁移特征和推理相关区域;然后,我们评估了它的功能相关性,用推理训练模型取代了指令调制模型中相应的层加权。 每个模型组内的匹配确保了相同的层结构和参数维度. 补充表1报告了精确的模型识别符、层数、代表点数以及结构和预测维度。

blocks.en:
The medical analysis additionally used Llama-3.1-8B-UltraMedical 21 , a medical specialization of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.
Its base-model reference was Llama-3.1-8B, and reasoning weights came from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B.
These models share 32 decoder layers with matching parameter dimensions.

医学分析还额外使用了Llama-3.1-8B-UltraMedical 21,是Llama-31-8B-Instruct的一个医学专业.
其基础模型参考文献为Llama-3.1-8B,推理权重来自DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B.
这些模型共享32个有匹配参数维度的解码层.

blocks.en: The training-trajectory analysis used OLMo 3 7B 18 : the pretrained model and the published intermediate stages of its supervised fine-tuning for reasoning, whose training continues with preference optimization and reinforcement learning after the stages examined here (Training-trajectory analysis).
blocks.zh: 训练-弹射分析使用了OLMo 3 7B 18:预训模型及其所公布的经监督的推理微调的中间阶段,其训练在此处所审查的阶段后继续进行偏好优化和强化学习(训练-弹射分析).

blocks.en: Datasets
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en:
Mathematical reasoning was evaluated on three benchmarks: MATH-87, a fixed 87-problem subset of MATH-500 5 ; 11 restricted to statements of 200–300 characters to reduce variation in input length; AIME 2024 14 (30 problems); and AIME 2025 15 (30 problems from AIME 2025-I and II).
Factual recall was evaluated on 500 TriviaQA questions 8 , and language modelling on 100 Wikipedia passages of 200–300 words.
blocks.zh:
对数学推理进行了三个基准的评价:MATH-87,MATH-500 5的一个固定的87个问题子集;11个限于200-300个字符的语句以减少输入长度的变化;AIME 2024 14(30个问题);和AIME 2025 15(30个来自AIME 2025-I和II的问题).
事实召回在500 TriviaQA问题8上被评价,100个维基百科段落的语言建模200–300字.

blocks.en:
For gradient comparisons using non-mathematical inputs, we used 100 English Wikipedia texts of 30–50 words and 100 random word sequences of the same length range.
Wikipedia texts were sampled with seed 17 from the November 2023 English Wikipedia release.
Random sequences were generated with seed 42 by choosing a length between 30 and 50 words and sampling English words with replacement from a general English word list.
Each input set was shared across the compared models.
blocks.zh:
在使用非数学输入进行梯度比较时,我们使用了100个英文维基百科文本的30–50字和100个相同长度范围的随机词序.
2023年11月英文维基百科发布时的"种子17"对维基百科文本进行了采样.
通过从一般的英语单词列表中选择30到50个字之间的长度和以替换来取样英语单词,随机序列与种子42一起生成.
每个输入集在比较模型中共享。

blocks.en:
Medical performance was evaluated on the complete 1,273-question, four-option MedQA-USMLE test set 7 .
For gradient analysis, we selected 87 questions from this test set whose question and option text contained 176–212 tokens under the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct tokenizer, excluding special tokens.
This range covered the 40th–60th percentiles of test-question length.
Sampling used seed 17 and was stratified by the correct option.
The fixed dataset version and selected question identifiers are included in the analysis source data.
blocks.zh:
在完整的1,273个问题、4个选项的MedQA-USMLE测试集7中评价了医疗业绩。
为了进行梯度分析,我们从这个测试集中选择了87个问题,其中的问题和选项文本在Llama-3.1-8B-指示符号下包含176-212个符号,不包括特殊符号。
这个范围包括测试提问长度的第40至第60百分位数。
取样使用了17种种子,并按正确的选择进行分级。
固定数据集版本和选定的问题识别符包含在分析源数据中.

blocks.en:
A graft copied weights from the reasoning-trained model into the corresponding layers of the architecturally matched instruction-tuned model.

blocks.en:

Each row contained similarities to all U U nodes, including itself, from the matrices used for gradient analysis before sparsification and embedding.
For both profiles, we excluded the final layer and applied a three-layer moving average, repeating the edge value at each boundary.

For the input comparison in Extended Data Table 1 a, we selected a span separately from each benchmark’s base–reasoning displacement profile using the region definition above.
For each matched model set and input benchmark, we enumerated contiguous spans of the same width that did not overlap the selected span, then sampled three starting positions without replacement using seed 0.
Weights from the same reasoning-trained model were used for the selected span and all three comparison grafts.
Each span was identified and evaluated using the same benchmark, and its graft accuracy was compared with the mean of these three comparison grafts.
The comparison spans could therefore change when the input benchmark changed.

blocks.en: Each mathematics problem was paired with an instruction to reason step by step and place the final answer in a boxed expression, then formatted with the model’s chat template. The repeat analyses used three generation runs with temperature 0.7 and top- p = 0.9 p=0.9 (Statistics and reproducibility). The main graft analysis and the evaluation across graft positions used one response per MATH-87 problem and run; AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 used four responses per problem and run. Generated-length analyses used these same sampled responses, with correct responses examined separately. For these repeat analyses, the requested maximum was 16,384 new tokens, except for Q7B, whose shorter context length limited responses to 4,096 tokens.

blocks.en: Forced generation length and held-out problems
blocks.zh: 强迫生成长度和搁置问题

blocks.en:
To test whether longer solutions alone reproduced the graft gains, each ungrafted instruction-tuned model was made to continue generating: whenever a response ended before a set number of generated tokens, the word “Wait” was appended and generation resumed, up to eight times on MATH-87 and sixteen on AIME, under the generation limit of 16,384 tokens that applied to every condition.
Responses could remain below the target length when generation stopped for repetition or the allowed resumptions were exhausted.
Two target lengths were set per host and benchmark using earlier region-graft evaluations and held fixed for this comparison (Extended Data Table 3 ).
MATH-87 targets were chosen to cover typical region-graft lengths; on AIME, the lower target was the median response length, rounded to 100 tokens, or the median of responses ending before the generation limit when the overall median reached it. The upper AIME target was 1.5 times the lower, capped at 12,000.
Q7B was not forced: its continued generations consisted of unrelated text, and its 4,096-token context left no room for longer solutions.
The forced conditions and their ungrafted and region-graft references were generated together in three generation runs, with the instruction and problem given in a single user turn, and are compared only with one another.
Responses that reached the generation limit were scored as generated.
blocks.zh:
为了检验单是较长的解决方案是否重复了增殖收益,对每个未增殖的指令调试模型都进行了继续生成:每当在设定的生成符号数之前的响应结束时,就会附加“等待”一词并恢复生成,最多在MATH-87上8次,在AIME上16次,在适用于每个条件的生成限制下16 384个符号.
当停止再生产或允许的恢复已用尽时,答复可能仍然低于目标长度。
利用较早的区域评估确定了每个东道方和基准的两个目标长度,并为这一比较作了固定(扩展数据表3)。
MATH-87目标被选以覆盖典型的区域-引力长度;在AIME上,较低目标为中位响应长度,四舍五入至100个令牌,或当整体中位数达到生成极限前结束的响应中位数. 上层AIME目标为下层的1.5倍,封顶为12,000.
Q7B并不是强迫的:它的连续几代由不相关的文本组成,它的4,096-token上下文没有再有解决的余地.
强制条件及其未移植的和区域移植的参考文献是用三个代号一起生成的,指令和问题都是用一个用户回合给出的,只能相互比较。
达到生成极限的响应被评为生成.

blocks.en: For the held-out evaluation, the 413 MATH-500 problems outside MATH-87 were answered once, in the first generation run, by each ungrafted model, its region graft and its reasoning-trained model, with the same single-turn format and scoring; the 87 selection problems were answered in the same runs for comparison.

blocks.en: Factual recall and language modelling
blocks.zh: 事实召回和语言建模

blocks.en:
For each of the six matched model sets, we evaluated the ungrafted instruction-tuned model, its MATH-87 region graft and the reasoning-trained model on the same TriviaQA questions and Wikipedia passages (Extended Data Fig. 3 b,c).
We sampled 500 questions without replacement from the no-context TriviaQA validation split using seed 42.
Prompts requested only the answer, without an explanation, and used each model’s chat template.
Each question received one greedily decoded response with a maximum of 400 new tokens.
A response was scored as correct if it contained any of the dataset’s answer aliases or normalized aliases, using case-insensitive substring matching.
Accuracy was the fraction of the 500 responses scored as correct.
blocks.zh:
对于6个匹配的模型集,我们评价了未移植的指令调制模型,其MATH-87区域调制模型,以及在同一TriviaQA问题和维基百科段落(Extended Data Fig. 3 b,c)上的推理训练模型.
我们用42号种子对500个问题进行了取样,但没有从无文字的 TriviaQA 验证中替换。
提示只要求答案, 没有解释, 并使用每个模型的聊天模板 。
每个问题都收到一个贪婪的解码回复,最多有400个新信使.
如果一个答复中含有数据集的任何答复的别名或普通化的别名,则使用对大小写不敏感子字符串的比对,则得分正确。
准确性是500份答复中准确的一小部分。

blocks.en:
For language modelling, we used the first 100 passages in our fixed Wikipedia sample of 200–300-word texts.
Passages were tokenized separately for each model, truncated to at most 2,048 tokens and evaluated without a chat prompt.
For each passage, we computed the mean next-token negative log-likelihood.
Reported perplexity was the exponential of the arithmetic mean of these passage-level losses, giving each passage equal weight.
These evaluations used one fixed set of questions and passages per model condition and were reported descriptively, separately from the three-run mathematics analyses.
blocks.zh:
在语言建模方面,我们使用了我们固定的Wikipedia样本200–300字文本中的前100段.
每个型号都分别标注过路标,最多可划为2 048个代币,且没有聊天提示。
每个段落,我们计算 平均的下位负对数。
报告的迷惑性是这些通道级损失的算术平均值的指数,使每个通道具有同等的权重.
这些评价采用了一套固定的问题和每个模型条件的段落,并且是描述性的,与三个运行的数学分析分开。

blocks.en:
The trajectory analysis used the 32-layer pretrained model Olmo-3-1025-7B and the published checkpoints of Olmo-3-7B-Think-SFT 18 at steps 1,000, 2,000, 4,000, 8,000, 12,000, 20,000 and 30,000 and at the end of supervised fine-tuning, referred to as stages.
We used MATH-87 inputs, centred linear CKA and diffusion-map embedding as described above.
OLMo uses post-normalized transformer blocks: the attention- and feed-forward-input sites sampled the residual stream, and their output sites preceded post-normalization; the remaining sites followed the definitions above, yielding 352 representation nodes.
Procrustes alignment used all representation nodes for translation as well as rotation, and displacement was averaged over the 11 sites per layer.
Signed CKA maps show stage-minus-base differences averaged over the node pairs in each layer pair, excluding a node’s similarity with itself.
Let s ℓ , k s_{\ell,k} denote the signed gradient 1 displacement from the base model at layer ℓ \ell and stage k k , and let K K denote the final stage.

We held layers 8–14 fixed throughout the trajectory and stage-graft analyses and calculated the same index for each of the 13 seven-layer spans that did not overlap layers 8–14, advancing their starting layer by one (Extended Data Fig. 4 b). These maturity comparisons retain all 32 layers, including the span 25–31; the displacement display in Fig. 4 a excludes the final layer.
Ungrafted stage evaluations used a 30,000-token generation limit, temperature 0.7 and top- p p 0.9.
On MATH-87, each evaluation generated one response per problem; reported counts averaged two generation runs for the base model, the 1,000-, 2,000- and 4,000-step stages and the endpoint, and used one run for the remaining stages.
Each AIME evaluation generated four responses per problem in one run, giving 120 responses per year.
Scoring used deterministic final-answer extraction and counted responses that reached the token limit or met the repetition-stop criterion as incorrect.
Stage accuracy and graft accuracy were evaluated under their respective generation limits and were not pooled.

blocks.en:
For stage grafts, we copied all parameters at layers 8–14 from each of the eight donor stages into the pretrained model, which served as the host because every stage descends from it, retaining the host’s remaining weights.
Generation used plain-text prompts, temperature 0.7, top- p p 0.9 and a 16,384-token response limit; the repetition-stop criterion was applied after generation, and correctness used the deterministic scoring described above.
MATH-87 used one response per problem in each of three generation runs; AIME used four responses per problem in one run.
Grafts and their ungrafted references shared the same problem-specific random seeds.
Gains were differences in correct-response counts from the ungrafted host, averaged over runs for MATH-87 and reported separately for the two AIME years, and are expressed as percentage points of 87 or 120 responses.
Supplementary Note “OLMo stage accuracy and graft positions across training” and Supplementary Table 6 extend the MATH-87 comparison to all 13 seven-layer spans starting at layers 0, 2, …, 24, using the same eight donor stages, three generation runs and scoring; Supplementary Table 7 gives the answer transitions for endpoint-donor grafts. The 8–14 observations are shared with Fig. 4 d; this positional grid is distinct from the non-overlapping structural-maturity spans above.

blocks.zh: 捐助方对生成的解决方案的相似性

blocks.en:
The behavioural analyses used the six instruction-tuned hosts ( B B ), their reasoning-trained donors ( D D ) and grafted models ( G G ).
For each model set, we scored the MATH-87 region graft, every two-layer-step position and the three comparison grafts of the benchmark-specific selection, giving 12, 13, 22, 11, 15 and 21 distinct positions for Q7B, L8B, Q14B, M3B, M8B and M14B, respectively.
All grafts within a model set had the same width.
Accuracy changes came from the positional evaluation and averaged three generation runs, with one response per MATH-87 problem and four per AIME problem per run.
Q7B responses in that evaluation had a 4,096-token generation limit, and other models had a 16,384-token limit.

行为分析采用了六个经指导调整的主机(B B),它们经过推理训练的捐赠者(D D)和移植模型(G G )。
对于每套模型,我们得分为MATH-87区域分级,每两层阶梯位置和基准特定选择的三个比较分级,分别给予Q7B,L8B,Q14B,M3B,M8B和M14B12个不同的位置.

该评价中Q7B的回复有4,096个托肯生成极限,其他模型有16,384个托肯极限.

Overlap-class values averaged the positions in each class, with the region graft providing full overlap. Supplementary Note “Interpreting donor-likeness scores” and Supplementary Table 8 separate the scores’ conditioning, sampling and numerical values.
For the AIME problem-level comparison, we classed each problem by whether the host’s modal answer over its 12 responses and the donor’s modal answer over nine responses were correct, and reported the region graft’s mean change in the fraction of correct responses over the problems the host did not solve, separately for problems the donor solved and failed.
Final-answer analyses used deterministic extraction, with 12 responses per graft and host (three generation runs, four responses per problem).
To identify a donor’s distinctive wrong answers, we used its modal answer over nine responses: the donor trace and eight previously collected donor responses.
Eligible problems had a parseable, incorrect donor mode differing from the host mode; the shared-wrong rate was the fraction of graft responses matching that donor answer.
For donor specificity, we correlated problem-level gains with each donor’s accuracy over the eight previously collected responses, restricting to problems the host had not answered correctly in all 12 responses, and subtracted the mean correlation with the other five donors from that with the own donor.
The previously collected donor responses used a different prompt placement from the donor traces.

关于AIME问题层面的比较,我们把每个问题归为东道方对12个答复的答覆和捐助方对9个答复的答覆是否正确,并报告了该区域对东道方未解决的问题的正确答题比例的中间变化,对捐助方解决和失败的问题分别进行。
最终解答分析采用定型提取法,每个引力和主机有12个响应(3代运行,每个问题有4个响应).
为了查明捐助者的明显错误答案,我们用其模式答案来取代9个答复:捐助者追踪和以前收集的8个捐助者答复。
符合资格的问题有与东道方模式不同的可解释的、不正确的捐助模式;共同错误率是符合捐助者答复的分数。
就捐助者的具体情况而言,我们把问题层面的收益与每个捐助者对以前收集的8份答复的准确性联系起来,仅限于东道方在所有12份答复中未能正确回答的问题,并减去了与其他5个捐助者之间的平均相关性。
以前收集的捐助者答复使用了不同于捐助者追踪的迅速位置。

blocks.en: Medical-model analysis and grafting
blocks.zh: 医疗模型分析和移植

blocks.en:
We compared Llama-3.1-8B and UltraMedical using the 87-question MedQA subset and the activation sampling, CKA, diffusion-map embedding and alignment procedures described above, and selected the longest contiguous span of elevated smoothed displacement using f = 0.70 f=0.70 , yielding layers 13–18.
Weights from this span were exchanged in both directions between UltraMedical and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and each graft was compared with its ungrafted recipient on the full MedQA test set.
blocks.zh:
我们利用87问题MedQA子集和激活取样、CKA、上述扩散图嵌入和对齐程序对Llama-3.1-8B和UltraMedical进行了比较,并使用f=0.70 f=0.70,产生第13至18层,选择了最长的连续线。
这个跨度的重量在超医学和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct之间双向交换,在完全的MedQA测试集上,每根引力与它的未引力接受者进行比较.

blocks.en:
To examine reasoning weights in the medical model, we grafted layers 15–22 from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B into UltraMedical; this eight-layer reasoning-related region was identified using MATH-87 and retained without re-estimating its boundaries on medical inputs.
We also evaluated eight-layer grafts starting at layers 0, 2, …, 24, giving 14 positions including the region graft, on MATH-87 and the full MedQA test set.
Each graft replaced all parameters within the selected layers while retaining the recipient’s remaining parameters, without further training; layer indices are zero-based and inclusive.
blocks.zh:
为了检查医学模型中的推理权重,我们从DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B将15–22层移植到UltraMedical;这个八层推理相关区域是使用MATH-87确定的,并保留下来,没有重新估计其对医学投入的界限.
我们还评估了从0,2,...,24层开始的八层地沟,在MATH-87和完整的MedQA测试集上给出了包括区域地沟在内的14个位置.
每一层都更换了所选层内的所有参数,同时保留接受者的剩余参数,而无需进一步培训;层指数是零基和包容性的。

blocks.en:
Generation used temperature 0.7, top- p = 0.9 p=0.9 and one response per question in one generation run.
Medical prompts presented the question and four options and requested a final answer letter A–D; mathematical prompts followed the instructions described under Generation and evaluation.
Grafted models and the ungrafted instruction-tuned reference used a 4,096-new-token limit; ungrafted UltraMedical responses, generated with a 16,384-token limit, were truncated to 4,096 tokens before scoring.
Generation also stopped when the last 256 generated tokens contained three consecutive repetitions of a 5–50-token sequence.
blocks.zh:
生成使用温度0.7,顶端-p=0.9p=0.9,每问题一个响应在一代运行中.
医疗提示提出了问题和四个选择,并要求最后答复字母A-D;数学提示遵循了Generation和评价下描述的指示。
牵引模型和未牵引的指令调试参考使用4,096-新托肯极限;未牵引的UltraMedical响应以16,384-托肯极限生成,在打分前被截到4,096个令牌.
当最后256个生成的代号包含一个5–50个托肯序列的连续三次重复时,世代也停止了.

blocks.en:
Mathematical answers were assessed using the deterministic and LLM-based judgments described above.
Medical answers were extracted deterministically from the final lines of each response, accepting a stated letter, a boxed letter or the text of a single option, and compared with the correct option; responses without a unique choice were counted as incorrect, and all responses remained in the accuracy denominator, including those stopped at the token limit or for repetition.
Medical retention was the fraction of the ungrafted recipient’s correct answers that remained correct after grafting, and the comparison in Fig. 5 b used the reasoning-related region and layers 10–17, selected from the position sweep as the span with the largest observed MATH-87 gain.
blocks.zh:
对数学答案的评估采用了上述基于确定性和LLM的判断。
医学答案是从每个答复的最后一行中提取确定的,接受一个说明的字母,一个框式字母或一个选项的文本,并与正确的选项进行比较;没有独特选择的答复被算作不正确,所有答复都保持在准确分母中,包括那些停留在符号限度或重复的.
留医是未提取的接受者正确答案中的一小部分,这些答案在提取后依然正确。 图5b中的比较使用了与推理有关的区域和10-17层,从位置扫射中选取,是观测到的最大MATH-87收益。

blocks.en: Statistics and reproducibility
blocks.zh: 统计和可复制性

blocks.en:
Generation runs used the random seeds 101, 202 and 303 in that order; where fewer runs were used, they were the first of these.
For the main six-host graft and positional analyses, the generation run was the repeat unit for uncertainty estimates, and the generation runs named in the main text and captions are these repeats.
Graft and no-graft conditions were paired within host and run; benchmark-level summaries first averaged the six hosts equally within each run.
For overlap-bin summaries, graft positions were first averaged within host, overlap class and run; the region graft supplied the full-overlap condition.
Points report the mean of the three runs, and intervals are two-sided 95% Student- t t confidence intervals across the three run-level estimates ( d ​ f = 2 df=2 ), without clipping to metric bounds.
Individual run estimates are shown in the aggregate accuracy and response-length summaries (Fig. 3 a and Extended Data Fig. 3 a).
For the comparison with other positions (Fig. 3 b), the region graft was compared with the mean of all other graft positions sharing its starting-layer parity within host and run.
For the length analysis, each graft’s median was divided by the corresponding no-graft median within model and generation run.
Separate ratios used all responses or only correct responses in both the grafted and ungrafted conditions; the correct-response subsets could therefore contain different problems.
Medians and ratios were first averaged across graft positions within model, overlap class and run.
The ratio summaries then weighted models equally within each run before summarizing the three runs.
Correct-response ratios were undefined when either condition had no correct response; undefined values were omitted at each averaging step, so the contributing positions and models could vary.
These length summaries are descriptive because generation length is measured after grafting.
Individual problems, graft positions and responses were not treated as independent replicates.
In the trajectory analysis, Pearson correlations between maturity and accuracy used the seven intermediate stages, excluding the endpoint because its maturity is fixed at one; stages and overlapping comparison spans are not independent replicates, and these associations are descriptive.
The donor-likeness, problem-level and answer comparisons are descriptive and carry no uncertainty intervals.
In the medical analysis, changes in correctness were paired by question, and 95% confidence intervals for accuracy differences were the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 10,000 paired item-bootstrap resamples within each benchmark (bootstrap seed 0); these pointwise intervals quantify item-sampling uncertainty in a single generation run and are not adjusted for the position search.
blocks.zh:
世代跑用随机的种子101,202和303按此顺序排列;在使用较少的跑时,它们是其中的第一个.
对于主要的六宿重力和位置分析,生成运行是用于不确定性估计的重复单元,生成运行在主文本和标题中命名的生成运行就是这些重复.
牵引和无牵引条件在主机内部对齐并运行;基准级汇总首先平均为每运行内6个主机的等效.
对于重叠周期摘要,首先在东道主内部平均分配重力位置,重叠等级和运行;区域重力提供了完全重叠的条件。
点报告三次运行的平均值,间隔为两个侧面95%的学生-t信任间隔,跨越三个运行级别估计值(df = 2 df = 2),而不剪切到度量界限.
个人运行估计数以总准确度和响应长度摘要(图3a和扩展数据图3a)显示。
就与其他职位(图3b)的比较而言,将区域调动与所有其他调动职位在东道方和运行方内部分享起步平价的平均值进行比较。
就长度分析而言,每个重力的中位数被模型和生成运行中相应的无重力中位数除以.
单独的比例在带宽条件和未带宽条件中都使用所有答复或只使用正确的答复;因此,正确的反应子集可能包含不同的问题。
中位数和比率首先在模型内各移植职位之间平均计算,重叠类别和运行。
在总结三次运行之前,比例汇总然后在每次运行中均匀加权模型。
当两个条件都没有正确反应时,正确反应比率没有确定;每个平均步骤都省略了未定义的数值,因此贡献位置和模式可能有所不同。
这些长度摘要是描述性的,因为生成长度是在移植后测量的.
个别问题、摘取的姿势和答复不被视为独立复制品。
在轨迹分析中,皮尔逊在成熟度和精度之间的关联使用了七个中间阶段,不包括终点,因为其成熟度固定在一个;阶段和重叠的比较跨度不是独立的复制,这些关联是描述性的.
捐助方的相似性、问题水平和答案的比较是描述性的,没有不确定性的间隔。
在医学分析中,正确性的变化是按问题对齐的,准确性差异的置信间隔95%是每个基准(bootstrap种子0)内1万对子项-bootstrap复标值的2.5和97.5百分位数;这些点位间隔在单代运行中量化了项目样本的不确定性,不根据位置搜索进行调整。

blocks.en:
In each of the six matched model sets, the base model is the pretrained reference, the instruction-tuned model is the host that receives a graft, and the reasoning-trained model is the donor that supplies the weights.
A graft replaces the weights of a contiguous span of host layers with the donor’s weights for the same layers, without further training.
The reasoning-related region, or region, is the span selected from base–reasoning displacement on MATH-87 (Methods).
A comparison graft has the region’s width at another position, and its overlap is the fraction of region layers that it contains.
A generation run is one sampling of responses for every condition; the three runs repeat the same problems.
MATH-87 is the fixed 87-problem subset of MATH-500 used to identify regions, and AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 contain 30 problems each.
CKA denotes centred kernel alignment.
Layer indices are zero-based and spans are inclusive.

一代运行是针对每个条件的一个响应样本;三个运行重复同样的问题.

blocks.en:
Units. Accuracy is the fraction of correct sampled responses within a generation run; on AIME, a run contains four responses to each of 30 problems.
Answer transitions are counted per problem, and an AIME problem is solved when at least two of its four responses are correct, so one correct response of four contributes to accuracy but not to the solved count.
The three runs repeat the same problems; intervals across runs therefore reflect variability in generation and not in the sampling of problems.

blocks.en: Supplementary Note: Interpreting donor-likeness scores
blocks.zh: 补充说明:解释类似捐助者的分数

blocks.en:
What the two scores compare. Both scores are zero for the host and one for the donor (Methods).
The donor-trace score R G R_{G} measures the fraction of host–donor KL divergence closed by grafting on shared donor-generated response prefixes, using each model’s prompt template.
Its token sums give longer traces more weight, and negative values indicate greater divergence from the donor than for the host on those response prefixes.
The generated-solution score pos G \operatorname{pos}_{G} is computed on each graft’s own solutions, so it compares responses that follow different prefixes, and it can lie outside the interval from zero to one.
It measures relative likelihood under donor and host and does not measure agreement of final answers or of solution strategy.
Because the two scores use different token sets, they need not move together and their magnitudes are not directly comparable.

它衡量捐助者和东道方的相对可能性,不衡量最后答案或解决战略的一致程度。
由于两个分数使用不同的符号集,它们不需要一起移动,它们的大小也不直接可比.
